title: ASSIGNMENT – 6
subtitle: Simulation of UDP Packet Transmission Using SimPy (Smart‑City Surveillance System)
name: Srikrishna O S

sections.heading: AIM
sections.paragraph: To simulate UDP packet transmission in a smart‑city surveillance system using SimPy. Roadside cameras generate video packets and send them to a central monitoring server over UDP; since UDP does not guarantee delivery, packets may be lost due to congestion and experience random transmission delays. The simulation models packet generation, transmission, random delay, and packet loss, and analyses the performance of UDP communication under different network conditions.

rows: Client and server implemented as SimPy process generators sharing a Store channel
All four scenarios ran end to end
Packets generated every interval with sequence number and generation timestamp
Uniform transmission delay in the configured range; random loss by probability
Delays up to 0.15 s and losses of 0, 2, 6, 15 packets observed
Arrival time and delay computed for every received packet
Average delay grew from 0.00 s to 0.10 s across scenarios
Missing packets identified from sequence number gaps
Missing lists printed, e.g. packets 3 and 5 in TC2
Higher loss probability with faster generation and bigger delays

sections.heading: LEARNING OUTCOMES
bullets: I modelled packet generation, transmission delay, and packet loss with SimPy processes.
I used a SimPy Store as the communication channel between client and server.
I computed delivery ratio, loss ratio, and delay statistics from real runs.
I detected missing packets from sequence number gaps.
I observed that higher loss probability and faster generation reduce the delivery ratio.
